# table-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-001 — A click on a pipe table cell opens a cell editor in place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-001.md) — When edit mode is on and the writer clicks a cell of a rendered pipe table, the extension SHALL open a region named "Markdown table cell editor" inside that cell, ask the host for the line range of the table block, and fill the cell text box with the raw Markdown of the cell or, when the block is not an editable pipe table, open the whole block in the raw Markdown editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-002 — Table row handle reorders body rows in edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-002.md) — When the writer drags the handle of a body row of a pipe table or a list-table in edit mode onto another row, or presses Alt+Up or Alt+Down on that handle, the extension SHALL move that row to the new position as one source edit and keep the header rows in place.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-003 — Row above inserts an empty row above the selected body row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-003.md) — When the writer presses Row above on the table bar with the cell editor in a body row, the extension SHALL insert an empty body row above the selected row, keep the text of every existing cell, save the table and reopen the cell editor in the new row, with Row above disabled in the header row.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-004 — Col left inserts an empty column to the left of the selected column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-004.md) — When the writer presses Col left on the table bar, the extension SHALL insert an empty column to the left of the selected column, keep the text of every existing cell and the style of every line, save the table and reopen the cell editor in the new column.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-005 — The row and column buttons also edit a plain list-table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-005.md) — When the writer opens a cell of a plain list-table (one header row, one-line cells, no title, label or option other than header-rows), the extension SHALL open the cell editor with the row and column buttons of the table bar and write the changed grid back as a list-table, leaving the text of an untouched list-table as it was.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-006 — The cell text box wraps and fits its text in the block editor font](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-006.md) — When a cell editor is open, the extension SHALL style its text box with the same editor font family, font size and line height as the block editor, wrap the cell text inside the cell with the text box fitted to it, and place a Done button and a Cancel button under the text box inside the cell, compact and wrapping within the column, and in edit mode keep every table cell at least 8em wide and the cell being edited at least 300 px wide.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-007 — Table column handle reorders columns in edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-007.md) — When the writer drags the handle above a column of a pipe table or a list-table in edit mode onto another column, or presses Alt+Left or Alt+Right on that handle, the extension SHALL move that column to the new position in every row as one source edit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-013 — A cell edit saves the whole table and moves between cells without reopening](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-013.md) — When the writer types in a cell text box, the extension SHALL remember each change in the table model so that the autosave carries the whole serialised table and not only the edited cell, and keep that model and the same edit session when the editor moves to another cell of the table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-018 — Enter, Done, leaving the cell or a click elsewhere commits the cell](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-018.md) — When the writer presses Enter in the cell text box, with or without Cmd, Ctrl or Shift, presses Done, leaves the cell editor or clicks elsewhere on the page, the extension SHALL insert no line break and commit the cell by posting the table as a final previewEditSave, and post no save when the table text equals the text the host sent and no autosave reached the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-025 — Escape cancels the cell edit, except during a composition](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-025.md) — When the writer presses Escape in a cell editor outside an IME composition and no autosave has reached the document, the extension SHALL close the editor, drop the typed text and send no final save, and, during an input-method composition, leave the editor open and post nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-026 — Cancelling after an autosave asks the host to restore the original table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-026.md) — When the writer cancels a cell edit after an autosave has reached the document, the extension SHALL post previewEditCancel so that the host restores the original table, and SHALL post nothing when no autosave happened.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-027 — The Cancel button does what Escape does](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-027.md) — When the writer presses Cancel in a cell editor, the extension SHALL cancel the edit exactly as Escape does.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-030 — Following a link or pressing Back or Next saves an open cell first](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-030.md) — When a cell editor holds typed text and the writer follows a link to another file or presses Back or Next, the extension SHALL post the cell's final save, flagged as a flush, before the navigation message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-034 — A host refusal is shown in the cell and keeps the typed text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-034.md) — When the host answers an open or a save of a cell editor with an error, the extension SHALL show the host's message in the status line of the editor, which is in the table bar once the text box exists, and on a refused save drop the pending navigation, leave the editor open and keep the typed text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-035 — Tab and the arrow keys move through the table cells](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-035.md) — When the writer presses Tab, Shift+Tab or an arrow key at the edge of the text in a cell text box, the extension SHALL move the editor to the next, previous or neighbouring rendered cell, with the caret at the end of its text (at the start for the cell to the right and the cell below), and leave the key to the browser or hand it to block-to-block navigation when no cell can take it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-044 — Typing a marker character over a selection in a cell wraps it as one undoable step](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-044.md) — When the writer types *, _, a backtick or ~ with text selected in the cell text box, the extension SHALL wrap the selection with that marker as one native edit and keep the text selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-045 — Undo and redo shortcuts stay in the cell text box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-045.md) — When the writer presses Cmd or Ctrl with Z or Y in the cell text box, the extension SHALL stop the event before it reaches any window listener and leave the undo or redo to the text box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-046 — A key the cell editor handled does not reach VS Code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-046.md) — When the cell editor or the table bar has handled Tab, Enter, Escape or an arrow key, the extension SHALL stop that key at the document so that VS Code runs no shortcut for it, and SHALL let keys the editor did not use, such as Ctrl+Tab, reach VS Code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-047 — Select all in the cell text box selects only the box text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-047.md) — When the writer presses Cmd+A (Ctrl+A elsewhere) in the cell text box, the extension SHALL stop the event at the document and leave the select-all to the text box so that only its text is selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-048 — A labelled table bar above the table tells the position and holds the buttons](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-048.md) — When a cell editor opens in a table, the extension SHALL create once a toolbar named "Table row and column actions" in the page flow directly above the table, showing seven labelled operation buttons and a status with the position of the selected cell, keep it while the editor moves between cells of that table, and remove it when the editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-055 — Row and column buttons add and remove rows and columns](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-055.md) — When the writer presses a row or column button of the table bar, the extension SHALL insert an empty row or column after the selected one (Row below, Col right; Row above and Col left insert before it, see SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-003 and SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-004) or delete the selected body row or column, store the text typed in the current cell, select the new or nearest remaining row or column, save the table and reopen the editor at the new position once the page rendered it again, with Row − and Col − disabled where the table model refuses the deletion, change only the lines the operation concerns (a column operation keeps the padding, the indentation and the outer pipes of every line), and close the popover, link panel and slash menu of the cell it leaves.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-064 — The table bar rides down with a tall table and stays visible](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-064.md) — When a cell editor is open and the table bar would lie under the sticky band or the preview controls, the extension SHALL keep the bar visible, by translating it down with a tall table to 4 px below the usable top and never past the end of the table, and by scrolling the page up by exactly the missing distance when the bar appears above the reading offset.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-070 — The List table button converts the edited table in one final save](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-070.md) — When the writer presses List table in the table bar, the extension SHALL post the pipe table, including the text typed in the current cell, as a {list-table} directive in one final save.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-073 — List table converts the table at the caret to a list-table in one edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-073.md) — When the caret is on any line of a pipe table or a simple HTML table in MyST mode, the extension SHALL offer the List table action, which replaces that table with its {list-table} form in one edit and puts the caret after it, and offer it nowhere else.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-074 — Pipe table converts the table at the caret to a pipe table in one edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-074.md) — When the caret is on any line of a {list-table} or a simple HTML table in MyST mode, the extension SHALL offer the Pipe table action, which replaces that table with its pipe table form in one edit and puts the caret after it, and offer it nowhere else.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-076 — A conversion that would lose content is refused with a reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-076.md) — When a conversion between a pipe table, a {list-table} and a simple HTML table would lose content or finds the table already in the target form, the extension SHALL change nothing and give a refusal reason, and text that is no table gets neither a conversion nor a reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-080 — A conversion keeps cells, escapes and alignment across forms](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-080.md) — When a pipe table, a {list-table} or a simple HTML table is converted to another form, the extension SHALL keep the cells and their escaped pipes, write the header row and the fence of the target form, and carry the alignment only where the target form has it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-085 — The table bar's cell group formats the cell text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-085.md) — When a cell editor is open, the extension SHALL add to the table bar, after a separator, a group named "Cell formatting" holding only the palette buttons allowed in a cell and no mode selector, and apply its buttons, their shortcuts and the cell slash menu to the cell text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-091 — Pipes in cell text are escaped and line breaks become spaces](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-091.md) — When the writer types text into a table cell or inserts text into a cell from the table bar, the extension SHALL write the pipes of that text as \\| so that the edited row keeps its cell count, and replace every line break of text inserted from the bar or pasted into the cell with a space.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-094 — Editing one cell changes exactly one line of the source](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-094.md) — When a table is parsed and written back after a cell edit, a row insertion, a row deletion or no change, the extension SHALL change only the line the edit concerns, so that a cell edit changes one line, a new row adds one line, a deleted row removes one line and an unchanged table gives back exactly the original text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-102 — Edge pipes are optional and only an escaped pipe stays in its cell](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-102.md) — When a table row is split into cells for editing, the extension SHALL accept rows with or without leading and trailing pipes, keep a pipe that is escaped with a backslash within its cell, and split a cell at every other pipe, also one inside a code span, as the preview does.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-106 — The Table action inserts a pipe table of the chosen size on its own lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-106.md) — When the writer runs the Table action with a size of R x C, 1 to 9 each, in a block editor, the extension SHALL insert after the end of the selection a pipe table of C columns with a header row of cells "Column 1" to "Column C", a --- delimiter row and R minus 1 empty body rows, add only the blank lines needed to set it apart, leave the selection untouched and select the first header cell, and insert nothing for a missing, malformed or out-of-range size.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-111 — Column alignment sets the colons of the caret's column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-111.md) — When the writer runs Column alignment with left, center or right, the extension SHALL rewrite only the cell of the delimiter row that belongs to the caret's column, with a colon on the left (left), on both sides (center) or on the right (right) of its dashes, keeping at least three dashes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-115 — Table with caption wraps the table at the caret in a table directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-115.md) — When the writer runs Table with caption, the extension SHALL wrap the pipe table at the caret in a :::{table} Caption directive, or insert a new captioned 2 x 2 table when the caret is outside a pipe table, and select the word Caption.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-117 — HTML table converts or inserts an HTML table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-117.md) — When the writer runs HTML table, the extension SHALL replace the pipe table at the caret with an HTML table whose first row is in thead and whose other rows are in tbody, and, with the caret outside a pipe table, insert a new HTML table of two columns and one empty body row after the selection, set apart by blank lines, with Column 1 selected.
